sections.label: WDA help for graduates
sections.summary: WDA programmes are extended to university graduates, and 17% of jobseekers assisted by WDA and e2i last year held degrees.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Mr Lim Swee Say)
sentences.text: WDA programmes and initiatives are indeed already extended to university graduates, including fresh graduates.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Mr Lim Swee Say)
sentences.text: In fact, last year, of the jobseekers assisted by WDA and the Employment and Employability Institute, 17% of them hold a degree qualification.

sections.label: PCP and CSP wage support
sections.summary: Under PCP, companies hiring PMETs aged 40 and above get 90% wage support up to $4,000; CSP pays 10% to 40% of first-year wages.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Mr Lim Swee Say)
sentences.text: For example, under PCP, companies which hire PMETs aged 40 and above will receive 90% wage support, or 20% more than those younger than age 40, up to a cap of $4,000 during the training and this is on top of existing training subsidies.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Mr Lim Swee Say)
sentences.text: At the same time, CSP is also specially designed for mid-career PMETs aged 40 and above.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Mr Lim Swee Say)
sentences.text: The Government pays between 10% and 40% of their first year's wages for mature PMETs deployed under CSP.

sections.label: PCP and CSP combined support
sections.summary: CSP, introduced in October, provides wage support for salaries from $4,000 to $7,000, so mature PMETs can be supported under PCP and CSP.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lim Swee Say
sentences.text: The Member is right that for many of the mature PMETs, their salary is likely to be more than $4,000.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lim Swee Say
sentences.text: That is the reason why, besides PCP which has been around for a few years, in October, we also introduced CSP.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lim Swee Say
sentences.text: Under CSP, we are able to provide wage support for salary ranges from $4,000 to $7,000.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lim Swee Say
sentences.text: So, in short, mature PMETs can be supported under our programmes through a combination of both PCP and CSP.
